notes.title: New Chinese Restaurant Now Open!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hello Chefs,[/b][/p][p]Get ready to turn up the heat — a brand-new culinary adventure has arrived! The [b]Chinese Restaurant[/b] is now open in [i]Clash of Chefs VR![/i] Prepare to cook up classic dishes using a brand-new cooking mechanic with woks, steamers, and dumpling baskets.[/p][p]Whether you're flipping woks or folding dumplings, you're in for a new challenge across 20 all-new levels, whether you're cooking solo or battling it out with friends! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33860469/5a2616774ea24ffc2d2801a8e9bc9d38b3582f47.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]🔥 What’s new?[/b][/p][p]✅ New Restaurant: Chinese-themed kitchen[/p][p]✅ New Cooking Mechanic: Wok stir-frying, steaming, dumpling making[/p][p]✅ 20 New Levels[/p][p]✅ Multiplayer Support: Real-time and asynchronous modes[/p][p]
🎥 [b]Watch the Gameplay Trailer[/b][/p][previewyoutube="4rho1k-xugo;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Stay tuned, we are still not done cooking still![/p][p][/p][p]See you in the kitchen,
[b]The Flat Hill Games Team[/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Bug fixing update
notes.notes:
Hello fellow Chefs,

The new update is up with a round of bug fixes, improvements and new features that you have requested. 

Leaderboards Points

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33860469/296cc69027548728342878ad7061d092dfdc4074.jpg[/img]

As there were a lot of questions and it was not clear how the leaderboards for multiplayer works, we have decided to add visual explanations of points you receive in multiplayer matches. 

Waiter Feedback

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33860469/bd0a4f80f310886571f34a3a09c65647971f2a1b.jpg[/img]

As a lot of fellow chefs requested, we have also worked on improving order feedback so now there are visual states that show what is wrong with the prepared order.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33860469/bfd1db7ffc0eea19777afe0700bd5a790a84d1d8.jpg[/img]
Here are new feedback icons and their explanations. We hope this would be helpful when delivering orders and making customers more satisfied!


Trash bin added 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33860469/3f90767caa6188f13acaffeb4e89300f5aed4433.jpg[/img]

As some of you mentioned you would like to add a trash bin in our game, we decided to make that possible. There is now one trash bin under the counter in each of our restaurants! 

Bug fixes

- Pasta won't cook fixed
- Achievement Burger King fixed
- Cups easily falling and spilling drink fixed
- Fries net easily drop back to fryer fixed
- Tortilla rotates when one side is rolled fixed
- Tortilla can get stuck in grill fixed
- Buttons on drink machine can be easily missed when touching fixed
- Picking up wrong ingredients - adjusted and improved

Enjoy cooking!

notes.title: New feature - Invite friends with code
notes.notes:
Hello fellow chefs,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33860469/18cca93f9a9cfabe6a57fb39c60a6e1495217102.jpg[/img]

In an effort to make it easier to join our game in multiplayer mode, it's now possible to join the game by entering that game's unique room code. In the main menu, after choosing multiplayer mode, you can generate unique room code that you can share with your friends. All they need to do is to enter the same code and join the match you created. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33860469/094d993c73ae8e646b326c4afb9fc8b60e4234a6.jpg[/img]

You can also choose which restaurant and what difficulty you want to challenge your opponent. We added this feature based directly on feedback from our user that we needed to simplify how participants join a game and to make possible joining players from different platforms in multiplayer matches. We hope you find this feature a great addition to Clash of Chefs VR!

Enjoy cooking!

notes.title: Clash of Chefs VR is out now!
notes.notes:
Hello fellow chefs,

We are beyond excited to announce we have completed the Early Access development of our delicious cooking game, Clash of Chefs VR, and officially launched the full version of the game!

Whether you've been with us all through Early Access or just now joining in,
we hope you have a wonderful time preparing the tastiest meals in all of the restaurants our game has to offer.

Our Launch Update is brimming with exciting new additions and improvements,
including the brand new Mexican restaurant with new recipes, new music and sounds, completely new waiter customization feature, new menu options, Achievements, and more!
 
On top of that, lots of improvements, fixes, and other enhancements ensure Clash of Chefs VR
is providing you with a great gaming experience.

Enjoy cooking!

notes.title: Full Release date announcement
notes.notes:
Hello fellow Chefs,

We have been quiet for some time and for a good reason, Our game will exit Early Access on [b]September 16th[/b] with a new Mexican restaurant and a lot of new features and bug fixes. Check out the release trailer that we have prepared for you:

https://youtu.be/EchOj6hIZag
Enjoy cooking!

notes.title: Major Bug fixing Update
notes.notes:
Hello fellow Chefs, 

We want you to know that we pay a lot of attention to your feedback and suggestions, so we prepared a major bug fixing update! Thanks to your feedback, we have a round of bug fixes, improvements and new features that you have requested. We are hoping that we managed to deliver everything you asked for, and if there are some things we missed, feel free to let us know. Thank you for your continuous support in our effort to give you great gaming experience!

Here is the list of things we delivered in this update:
[list]
[*] Better detection of ingredients pick up 
[*] Delivering order bug fix
[*] Burning noodle bug fix
[*] Cooked noodle stick to spoon bug fix
[*] Cheese grater gets stuck inside the counter bug fix
[*] Added various background music and ambient noise 
[*] Support for grabbing items on grip button 
[*] Position of a player in counter adjusted and aligned when switching restaurants
[*] Vibration added for various interactions 
[*] Performance improvements
[/list]
[h2]Improved instruction panel[/h2]

Since a lot of you mentioned that the order instruction could be more visible we have worked on improving our instruction panel to make it more clear about what ingredients are requested. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33860469/02f89e1604a5d1c230b1ab1199065463a065f7ac.png[/img]

[h2]Improved UI[/h2]

Your feedback also mentioned that some text in our Menu was difficult to read, so we worked on improving text size and overall visibility. We believe that we managed to adjust it, but if you think there is still a space for improvement please let us know. All suggestions are welcome!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33860469/c2860a9c6fd6891ed933186702b6b00c2a559295.png[/img]

[h2]Voice chat [/h2]

We've added in-game voice chat in multiplayer! Now you can chat with the opponent chef as you are competing in a multiplayer match. With the voice chat our restaurants can be a great place for you to communicate more with your friends and fellow chefs. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33860469/7b2c239a91130e73f33d1b7f5e2def3cc2355b8d.png[/img]

[h2]Multiplayer rematch[/h2]

We have received a lot of requests for a rematch option at the end of the multiplayer match, and we've delivered! You can now play again with your opponent, and you can also change the restaurant you want to compete in before the rematch starts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33860469/e6949b7223cea5ed8b6f6f35c51bd6c1805c51ed.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33860469/c3c51ea837d6e5edd144bda67e1019aa50bdc23d.png[/img]

Expect more exciting content coming soon. 
Enjoy cooking!

notes.title: New Tutorial Update
notes.notes:
Hello fellow Chefs, 

Here we are back again with a new update! This time we have added Tutorial videos for both restaurants at the beginning of each level. The tutorial videos will introduce the player to the foundations of the gameplay and the game mechanics. 

[h2]American Restaurant Tutorial[/h2]

American Restaurant Tutorial videos include instructions for mechanics such as cooking burger and bacon, cutting vegetables, pouring drinks and adding toppings. It is also shown how to check for an order on the Instruction Panel, put order on a plate and how to serve and deliver. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33860469/62e9cebdb20b8223a479bd8c3967db7c476942fc.jpg[/img]

[h2]Italian Restaurant Tutorial[/h2]

Italian Restaurant Tutorial videos, besides instructions for getting an order and feedback from a waiter, include main mechanics such as stretching pizza dough, cooking pizzas and pastas, pouring drink and sauces, shredding cheese and delivering orders.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33860469/bdb649dd20b0a9ccc13c770b928e2c656d1eb89d.jpg[/img]

[h2]Enlarge Videos [/h2]

Each video has a zoom to view option so you can concentrate on a specific mechanic that you need help with. You can choose to disable tutorials by checking Don't Show Again, but it will be left optional to play from Options and Ingame menu any time you need help. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33860469/7edc6506881d5417f885a308e810eb45dd8b1ff9.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New Localization Update!
notes.notes:
Hello fellow Chefs, 

We are proud to share an important update - Localization! This means that you can now play the game in your own language. We are aware that our game doesn't have that much text, but we still want to make your gaming experience as enjoyable as we can. 

So, here's the complete list of languages that have been added to the game:
[list]
[*] French
[*] Japanese
[*] Korean
[*] Italian
[*] German
[*] Russian
[*] Chinese
[*] Spanish
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33860469/acfd6c90b0e016aaf117d02da6701fd4b3481e8f.png[/img]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]

After receiving your feedback from our last update we have decided to add Leaderboards to the End Panel after every completed single player level and at the end of Endless mode. You can now check your score and rank immediately after you have finished playing and also in the Main Menu. Thanks for your continuous support and feedback! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33860469/9c7aaa209e8c5f3a8fd2cf453062d6f4298a0a80.png[/img]

[b]Bug fixes and optimization:[/b]
[list]
[*] Performance optimization 
[*] Resolved Valve Index bug with grating cheese
[*] Fixed various minor issues
[/list]

notes.title: NEW UPDATE: MENU, LEADERBOARDS AND MORE
notes.notes:
Hello fellow Chefs,

Check out what we have prepared in the new update. 

[h2]Closer kitchen counters[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33860469/acc8d0b1e456af72c9804ffbc1b65c2fc7618255.jpg[/img]


We have noticed that in multiplayer matches kitchen counters were a bit too far from each other and it was hard for players to interact. And we all love to throw things at one another, so we decided to bring counters closer. We hope that this will improve interactions and you`ll enjoy the battles even more! 

[h2]New and improved MENU[/h2]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/hWpz7kPllKaEMkMHLM/giphy.gif[/img]


In this update we welcome you with a completely new Menu with improved Interface and new features. We have been working on providing faster and easier use of Menu features for our players. 

[h2]Singleplayer leaderboards[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33860469/f2520da1220504729a06fad2e22d9b9104a7607d.jpg[/img]


If you`ve already been climbing on our Multiplayer leaderboards, we hope you`ll try to get your name on our global leaderboard for every level in the single player mode. From this update you can compete in single player levels as every level will contain a leaderboard that you can check out in our new Menu.  

[h2]Delivered order points[/h2]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/j2SZgcyYlDo9ei66Zv/giphy.gif[/img]


In our last update we have added visual feedback from the waiter that shows what is wrong with the order, and now we decided to add Delivery points when you deliver good order so you can see right away how much points you have earned.

[h2]Bug fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Resolved Valve Index bug with pouring pasta and grating cheese
[*] Multiplayer stability issues
[/list]

notes.title: NEW UPDATE - SCORING SYSTEM AND MULTIPLAYER UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hello fellow Chefs,

The new update is up and with it new scoring system and multiplayer features:

[h3]Multiplayer match progress panel[/h3]

Multiplayer match now has a time limit and the goal is to deliver as many orders as possible in that time. During a multiplayer match you can now check both player and opponent's  progress and time left till end of the match . Player with more points wins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33860469/38405f7e3449345085da71a6e0f6e80478b61d17.jpg[/img]

[h3]New scoring system[/h3]

Some orders are more complex to make than others so now there is a different score value based on how difficult is it to make.  Also, there is a score multiplier based on how fast player delivers it.
Single player levels have new scoring system as well.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33860469/a7b65d3ab866ee1da8342b59caf2dcc5e6ab00a0.jpg[/img]

notes.title: NEW UPDATE AVAILABLE NOW!!!
notes.notes:
Hello fellow Chefs, 

Since the beginning the community has been amazing in sharing invaluable feedback with us about your experiences and what other additions you'd like to see in the game.
We have read all of your feedback, suggestions and reviews, therefore we decided to make a prioritized list of issues and work on them first. 
We started with the most critical ones and largely improved game mechanics. The new update is now up! Here's what we did so far:


New features:

- Two new game modes - Endless and Casual

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33860469/90fe484abbf8bc8180b20aedead124b060547361.png[/img]

- New and improved MENU

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33860469/50a12dd54110fe06fcec50353c9898162586128e.png[/img]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/1zKPk70APyLa48L1T9/giphy.gif[/img]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/6EgwmZqp19mpzylklj/giphy.gif[/img]


Bug fixes:
